ranked.headline: Generative and graph models infer cell states and spatial gene structure
ranked.summary: Generative and graph-based models now address alignment, annotation, imputation and reconstruction in single-cell and spatial data.

ranked.headline: Molecular representation learning extends to affinity, kinetics and toxicity prediction
ranked.summary: Benchmark curation and input-modality comparisons now test whether learned representations generalize across molecular and protein tasks.

ranked.headline: Modeling technical variability before biological inference in sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications explicitly model normalization, scale, and quantification uncertainty in ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, and transcript-level analyses.

ranked.headline: LLMs and deep models for variant, protein, and trial outcome prediction under scrutiny
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether genomic and clinical ML predictors are calibrated, interpretable, and robust to confounders and leakage.

ranked.headline: Graph-aware and callable-site methods reformulate standard population-genetic inference
ranked.summary: Population-scale sequence data increasingly demand graph-aware and callable-site-aware tools for genotyping, selection, and introgression.

ranked.headline: Conditional language models steer biological sequence design toward defined targets
ranked.summary: Multiple November 2025 preprints and two published papers apply explicit conditioning or reinforcement learning to steer biological sequence generation.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide readouts are linking cancer origin, DNA repair and genomic instability
ranked.summary: Mutational, epigenomic and regulatory readouts are now being joined to questions of tumor origin, repair defects and genomic instability.

ranked.headline: Stochastic molecular rules set population-level expression distributions and noise
ranked.summary: Recent preprints link microscopic reaction and promoter rules to emergent distributions, treating stochasticity as mechanism rather than superimposed noise.

ranked.headline: Input representation reshapes DNA language models for variant and sequence tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test tokenization, patching, and embedding alternatives against benchmarked DNA foundation models.

ranked.headline: Lipids and ligands reshape conformational energy landscapes in membrane proteins
ranked.summary: Recent MD and enhanced-sampling studies quantify how lipids, ions and ligands shift protein conformational energy barriers.

ranked.headline: Parallel and out-of-core software accelerates genomic read and interval processing
ranked.summary: Recent tools report substantial speedups and laptop-to-HPC scaling for core single-cell and genomic data processing steps.

ranked.headline: Spatial and single-cell profiling maps prognostic tumor niches and cell states
ranked.summary: Spatially resolved and cross-tumor network methods now link transcriptomic cell states to survival and tissue context.

ranked.headline: Deep learning maps tissue morphology to spatial omics and clinical endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply deep learning to histology, spatial proteomics and multi-omics for prediction and interpretability.

ranked.headline: Structure-based computation guides ligand, antibody, and GPCR design decisions
ranked.summary: Simulation and structure-based design tools are now being applied across disordered proteins, GPCRs, antibodies, and small-molecule hit discovery.

ranked.headline: Simulation-based inference is being applied to parameter estimation in epidemic models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair likelihood-free inference tutorials and head-to-head comparisons with mechanistic epidemic models.

ranked.headline: Decomposing multi-omics and regulatory data into interpretable gene and signature modules
ranked.summary: Recent methods extract interpretable gene modules and signatures from multi-omics and compositional data, with benchmarking and application studies reported.

ranked.headline: Fitted models are validated against independent neural measurements across scales
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study test fitted models against MEG/EEG, fMRI, and gene expression data to probe neural mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Identifiability and parameter estimation methods for mechanistic biological models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published workflow address identifiability, sampling, and state-parameter estimation for dynamical biological models.

ranked.headline: Ensemble models and force fields are tied to SAXS, NMR, and ITC observables
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and all-atom models now carry parameters for modified residues and are checked against measured structural and thermodynamic data.

ranked.headline: Coupling mechanical loading to multiscale models of tissue and matrix behaviour
ranked.summary: Recent work quantitatively links stress inference, bond kinetics and matrix remodelling across scales, from epithelia to aortic valves.

ranked.headline: Calibrated benchmarks guide method choice in protein structure and library analysis
ranked.summary: Recent studies replace default tool outputs with benchmarked criteria for homodimer calls, BGC similarity, library clustering, and ddG prediction.

ranked.headline: Robust models resolve protein abundance from noisy mass spectrometry measurements
ranked.summary: Proteomics studies now pair decomposition, compositional transforms, and robust statistics to handle heterogeneous and mixed mass spectrometry measurements.

ranked.headline: k-mer and embedding methods refine taxonomic classification of genomic sequences
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs k-mer, word2vec and primer-aware methods with curated benchmarks for sequence classification and species demarcation.

ranked.headline: Harmonized antibody-antigen data meets interface-level structural analysis tools
ranked.summary: ASD's 1,097,946 harmonized antibody-antigen interactions now sit alongside interface-level analysis tools such as COCOMAPS 2.0.

ranked.headline: Methods refine calibrated, context-resolved genetic association and fine-mapping
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add calibration, regulatory prioritization and single-cell distributional modelling to GWAS and QTL analysis.

ranked.headline: Long-read and structural context are resolving isoform-level regulatory annotation
ranked.summary: Long-read assemblies and 312 brain transcriptomes now expose isoform-level and structural variation that gene-level models cannot represent.

ranked.headline: Scalable algorithms for viral discovery, read alignment, and amplicon and genome analysis
ranked.summary: Recent items report large speedups, including 44x for RNA virus screening, and low-memory designs for pan-genome and large-genome alignment.

ranked.headline: Structure and sequence models predict nanopore readouts for proteins and XNA bases
ranked.summary: Computational models now connect pore structure, sequence, and ionic current for nanopore sensing and sequencing applications.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models link mutation fitness effects to genome and virulence evolution
ranked.summary: Explicit fitness-inference and protein-biophysics models now test mutation effects against E. coli genomic sites, phage viability, and HIV virulence.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs and bias correction methods validated on large sequencing datasets
ranked.summary: Recent work evaluates sequencing tools against orthogonal confirmation and cohort-scale datasets of thousands of samples.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for isotope flux, microbiome, and microbial interaction modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe open-source software for metabolic flux, isotope-labeling, microbiome, and microbial interaction analysis.

ranked.headline: Graph models link expression data to pathway activity and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply network and higher-order context to single-cell and spatial expression data for perturbation and pathway inference.

ranked.headline: Knowledge-guided and contrastive models integrate heterogeneous single-cell data
ranked.summary: Atlas-scale single-cell foundation models, benchmarks, and multimodal priors now target transfer across datasets, modalities, and species.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings reveal motifs, local structure, and remote homology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat pretrained protein language model embeddings as searchable geometry for motif, structure, and homology tasks.

ranked.headline: Assessing assumptions and uncertainty in phylogenetic and phylodynamic inference
ranked.summary: Recent work quantifies how tree-topology, fossil-calibration and coalescent-model assumptions propagate into divergence times and growth estimates.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and adaptations of computational methods for RNA and cell-free DNA omics data
ranked.summary: Cell-free DNA, long-read RNA, and pooled-batch datasets demand methods that handle noise, sparsity, and batch effects before biological inference.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for interpreting genomic variants from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend variant interpretation to copy number, pharmacogenomic, and FFPE artifact problems in sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed models reconstruct cell population dynamics from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and foundation-model frameworks are beginning to link molecular, cellular, and tissue-scale measurements to quantitative biological predictions.

ranked.headline: Embedding and retrieval conditioning move from protein search into generative design
ranked.summary: Learned inverse-folding embeddings and retrieval augmentation now condition generative protein sequence, structure, and docking models.

ranked.headline: Negative-set design and data construction govern binding prediction reliability
ranked.summary: Recent TCR-pMHC, MHC-peptide, and antibody affinity studies test how reference data and feature choice shape prediction accuracy.
